page_title: HAV 1-1 MON | Le Havre v Monaco 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antoine Joujou (Le Havre). It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.

90+1' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here is a change. Yassine Kechta is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre).
89' Substitution. Josue Casimir is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
88' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
87' The resulting corner from Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is cleared by the defence.

87' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' The substitution is prepared. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Breel Embolo.
86' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
85' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Philipp Kohn, who makes a comfortable save.
84' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Andre Ayew. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
81' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Caio Henrique will be replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
81' The referee signals a substitution. Jordan Teze (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Vanderson.
80' A cross by Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
80' The resulting corner, taken by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre), comes to nothing.

76' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
73' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Rassoul Ndiaye comes onto the pitch because Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
68' Looks like Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
66' Substitution. Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fode Ballo-Toure walks off.
66' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) replaces Koka.
66' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Monaco as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
65' There's a break in play and referee Clement Turpin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Monaco using VAR. This could be interesting!
64' Surely that's handball by one of the Le Havre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
64' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
64' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monaco.
63' Referee Clement Turpin signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Monaco players have a reason to celebrate!
62' The Monaco players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Mika Biereth (Monaco) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
59' Clement Turpin blows his whistle as Mika Biereth (Monaco) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
58' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends a short pass into the box, Breel Embolo takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
57' Corner kick. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is ready to send the ball into the box.
51' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Adi Hutter has made a change at the break. Al Musrati has come on in place of Lamine Camara (Monaco).
46' Adi Hutter makes a switch. Takumi Minamino is coming on in place of Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' CHANCE! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
42' Foul! Caio Henrique (Monaco) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
40' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
38' Loic Nego (Le Havre) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
31' The ratio of the ball possession is 35:65.
26' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
23' Clement Turpin has issued a yellow card to Koka (Le Havre).
22' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Junior Mwanga sends a long raking pass onto the head of Koka (Le Havre), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
17' Breel Embolo (Monaco) rises above the defence and heads the ball low, into the middle of the goal. The keeper is there waiting and denies him.
15' Mika Biereth (Monaco) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Clement Turpin who sees an offensive foul.
14' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a chip pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quickest to intercept the ball.
10' A pass by Vanderson (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' A precise low pass is received by Issa Soumare (Le Havre), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
7' Chance! Breel Embolo (Monaco) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
6' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.

4' Vanderson (Monaco) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Monaco will kick-off.
Clement Turpin is introduced as the referee for today's match.
